name: helm-values-identity
description: LLM-based extraction of service identity from .example production Helm values

extractions.name: production_identity
extractions.description: Extract service identity from production Helm values using LLM
extractions.prompt_hint: From this Helm values YAML, extract service identity as JSON: {"iam_role": "...", "dns_aliases": ["subdomain.example.global"], "queue_identifiers": ["queue-name-1"], "database_connection": ["host:port/dbname"], "service_urls": {"target-service": "http://..."}}. Look at iamRole field, ingress subdomain, and ALL env vars in configMaps.configmap.env for URLs (*_API, *_URL, *_HOST), SQS queues (*SQS*, *QUEUE*), databases (*DB*, *DATABASE*, *REDIS*, *DYNAMO*). Return ONLY the JSON object.
